measurement_methods.geometry: BBox from alpha>0; height=bottom-top; foot row=bottom-1; center of mass=sum(x*alpha)/sum(alpha), coordinates0..63; partial alpha means1..254
measurement_methods.white_edge_candidates: Bright near-neutral pixels (all RGB>=210, max-min<=45), 8-connected components at most6 pixels, touching transparent alpha boundary, restricted to inspected head/hair mask and y<45; candidates are not an exhaustive human count and are not automatically erased

hf1_claude_reference_white_specks.note: Preserved external measurement; our narrower candidate detector is reported separately, not claimed equal

measurement_methods.material_masks: Explicit native per-direction spatial ROIs + listed RGB gold palette; coordinates of every counted pixel included; shared colours require regions in later polishing
measurement_methods.lantern: Visual classification: no hanging lantern; belt/glove gold pixels listed separately and must not be confused with a lantern
measurement_methods.hands: Anatomical left/right, native64 coordinates; profile far hands marked estimated, draw-order layers are proposals
